decisions.reason: The Cu-Interposer was publicly launched at SEMICON Europa as a flagship of the firm's announced shift toward multifunctional packaging wafers, so the heavy investment and visible commitment favour persisting, and weak results can still be blamed on temporary pandemic and market-ramp effects.
Wafer Universe is a founded brand, close to the core business and presented as a strategic focus, so dropping it would undo a public commitment while it costs little to keep running.

Glass-based circuit boards are distant from the core and were never featured as a flagship, which makes them the weakest candidate, but sunk development effort and the hope that glass substrates will grow argue for keeping them for another year.
